entities.name: Swarmweaver
entities.description: A wickerfolk of Duskmourn with a corpse-bee hive for a head, formed when an elvish scout grabbed a wickerfolk hand.

entities.name: Hauntwoods
entities.description: Forest where the scout disturbed the hive.

entities.name: Corpse-bees
entities.description: Bees that burrowed into the scout.

entities.name: The House
entities.description: Duskmourn's House, which the Swarmweaver roams.

events.summary: An elvish scout in the Hauntwoods disturbs a hive of corpse-bees, which burrow into him.
events.quote: an elvish scout accidentally disturbed a hive of corpse-bees

events.summary: Grabbing a wickerfolk hand, he is transformed but the bees remain inside him.
events.quote: the bees were still inside of him

events.summary: The Swarmweaver roams the House seeking survivors for its swarm to colonize.
